content: Singing is an important way of human expression and the techniques of singing synthesis have broad applications in different prospects including virtual human, movie dubbing and so on. Traditional singing synthesize systems are based on concatenative BIBREF1 or HMM BIBREF2 based approaches. With the success of deep learning in Text-to-Speech, some neural singing synthesis methods have also been proposed recently. For example, BIBREF3 introduces a singing synthesis method using an architecture similar to WaveNet BIBREF4. It adopts lyrics and notes as input and generates vocoder features autoregressively for final singing voice synthesis.
